title: 8 Days & 7 Nights Yoga Retreat in Uluwatu Bali
metaTitle: 8 Days Yoga Retreat In Uluwatu Bali
metaDescription: Rejuvenate your mind & body with the best 8-Day Yoga Retreat in Uluwatu, Bali. Experience yoga, meditation & healing at the serene Bali Yoga School.
summary: A 8 days & 7 nights yoga retreat in Uluwatu with daily pranayama & meditation, Hatha Vinyasa yoga, healing sessions and 7 complimentary Balinese massages.
intro: Give yourself the gift of stillness and sunshine with a soul-soothing escape to Uluwatu, Bali — where golden sands meet the calm rhythm of the sea. Immerse yourself in serenity as you unwind beneath the tropical sky, leaving behind the rush of daily life.

Nestled amidst lush greenery, our yoga retreat center features peaceful private rooms, two inviting swimming pools, and open garden spaces where you can soak in the sun or read your favorite book in tranquility. Each day unfolds with energizing yoga sessions, pranayama, meditation, and Hatha Vinyasa flow classes guided by our experienced teachers who blend ancient yogic wisdom with modern techniques.
When you’re not on the mat, explore the wonders of Uluwatu — from sacred cliffside temples and oceanfront cafes to scenic beaches and cultural charm.

dining.text: We serve plant-based meals, prepared with the highest standards of hygiene, cleanliness, and love to support your yoga journey. Lunch & Dinner are not served on Sundays.

arrival: The best and most convenient way to travel to Bali Yoga School is to take a flight to Denpasar Bali airport. Denpasar Bali airport is merely 38 km away from our school. As soon as you book your flight, forward us your flight details and we will send our driver to meet you from Denpasar Bali airport and drive to the school.

policies.title: Class timings
items: The Management team holds the right to change the timings of the classes if it is needed.

policies.title: Booking Process
items: In order to book for retreat kindly deposit the Advance booking amount of 150 USD. Balance should be paid on arrival either by card, cash or Online transfer. An official confirmation letter concerning your program will be sent to you shortly after successful advance booking fee.

policies.title: Refund Policy
items: Advance Booking deposit is non refundable, we accept date rescheduling. If you cancel the course after joining, we accept the cancellation but the course fees will not be refunded with the cancellation.
